template-library.meaning: Yes: thousands; partly: dozens, or community-made only; no: none.

terraform-compatible.name: Runs Terraform files
terraform-compatible.question: Do existing Terraform files and providers work unchanged?
terraform-compatible.meaning: Yes: fully; partly: mostly; no: no.

threads.name: Threaded replies
threads.question: Can you reply in a thread so side conversations don't clutter the channel?
threads.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: quotes or simple replies only; no: no.

tiny-script.name: Light on your site
tiny-script.question: Is the tracking script small (under about 5 KB) so pages stay fast?
tiny-script.meaning: Yes: under 5 KB; partly: 5 to 30 KB; no: larger.

traces.name: Traces
traces.question: Can it follow one request across many services (tracing)?
traces.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: limited; no: no.

tracker-warnings.name: Warns about trackers and ads
tracker-warnings.question: Does it warn you when an app tracks you or shows ads?
tracker-warnings.meaning: Yes: clear labels; partly: some information; no: no.

tracking-stats.name: Open and click stats
tracking-stats.question: Does it show who opened an email and clicked its links?
tracking-stats.meaning: Yes: opens, clicks and bounces; partly: some of these; no: none.

translate-documents.name: Translate whole documents
translate-documents.question: Can it translate whole files, not just typed text?
translate-documents.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: some formats; no: no.

turn-by-turn.name: Spoken turn-by-turn directions
turn-by-turn.question: Does it guide you with spoken directions while driving or walking?
turn-by-turn.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: on-screen only; no: no.

tv-apps.name: TV apps
tv-apps.question: Are there apps for smart TVs and streaming sticks (Android TV, Fire TV, Apple TV, Roku)?
tv-apps.meaning: Yes: three or more of them; partly: one or two; no: none.

two-step-login.name: Two-step sign-in
two-step-login.question: Can your users turn on two-step sign-in?
two-step-login.meaning: Yes: several methods; partly: one method; no: no.

twofa-import.name: Imports from other code apps
twofa-import.question: Can you bring codes in from Google Authenticator, Authy and others?
twofa-import.meaning: Yes: from most apps; partly: from some; no: re-add each one.

typo-tolerance.name: Forgives typos
typo-tolerance.question: Does search still find results when people misspell?
typo-tolerance.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: needs setup; no: no.

unattended-access.name: Access when nobody's there
unattended-access.question: Can you connect to a computer when nobody is in front of it?
unattended-access.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: with setup; no: someone must accept each time.

unified-inbox.name: All accounts in one inbox
unified-inbox.question: Can you see several email accounts in one combined inbox?
unified-inbox.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: several accounts but separate inboxes; no: one account only.

update-rollback.name: Undo a bad update
update-rollback.question: If an update breaks something, can you roll back to the previous version easily?
update-rollback.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: possible with setup; no: no.

uptime-checks.name: Uptime checks
uptime-checks.question: Can it check from outside that your site is up?
uptime-checks.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: through an add-on; no: no.

usage-billing.name: Billing by usage
usage-billing.question: Can it bill subscriptions by how much customers use?
usage-billing.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: flat subscriptions only; no: no.

user-sso.name: Users sign in with your app's accounts
user-sso.question: Can your users post feedback with their existing account on your app?
user-sso.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: paid or limited; no: separate accounts.

video-generation.name: Makes videos
video-generation.question: Can it make short videos from text or images?
video-generation.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: through an add-on; no: images only.

video-link-auto.name: Adds a video call link
video-link-auto.question: Does each booking get a video call link automatically?
video-link-auto.meaning: Yes: with several video services; partly: one service; no: no.

video-rooms.name: Video and voice rooms
video-rooms.question: Can you add video and voice rooms to your app?
video-rooms.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: voice only; no: no.

video-templates.name: Ready-made templates and effects
video-templates.question: Does it come with ready-made templates, text styles and trendy effects like CapCut?
video-templates.meaning: Yes: a large built-in set; partly: a few, or community downloads; no: none.

voice-assistant.name: Voice assistant
voice-assistant.question: Can you control things by talking to it, like Alexa?
voice-assistant.meaning: Yes: built in and works well; partly: possible but rough or needs setup; no: no.

voice-chat.name: Talk by voice
voice-chat.question: Can you talk to it and hear it answer?
voice-chat.meaning: Yes: both ways; partly: one way; no: text only.

voice-typing.name: Voice typing
voice-typing.question: Can you type by speaking?
voice-typing.meaning: Yes: built in, on your phone; partly: hands off to another app; no: no.

voting.name: Upvotes
voting.question: Can people upvote posts or ideas so the popular ones rise?
voting.meaning: Yes: voting and sorting by votes; partly: likes but no sorting; no: no voting.

vst-plugins.name: Uses standard plugins (VST)
vst-plugins.question: Does it load standard audio plugins (VST, LV2, AU)?
vst-plugins.meaning: Yes: the common types; partly: one type, or limited; no: no.

weakness-updates.name: Keeps up with new weaknesses
weakness-updates.question: Is its list of known weaknesses updated automatically?
weakness-updates.meaning: Yes: automatic feeds; partly: manual updates; no: no.

web-admin.name: Web admin panel
web-admin.question: Can you manage users and devices from a web page?
web-admin.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: limited; no: config files only.

web-app-scan.name: Scans websites
web-app-scan.question: Can it test websites and web apps for weaknesses?
web-app-scan.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: limited; no: no.

web-push.name: Browser notifications
web-push.question: Can it send notifications to web browsers?
web-push.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: some browsers; no: no.

web-search.name: Searches the web
web-search.question: Can it look things up on the web while answering?
web-search.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: with setup or a plugin; no: no.

who-sees-post.name: Choose who sees each post
who-sees-post.question: Can you pick who sees each post (friends, family, public)?
who-sees-post.meaning: Yes: per-post audiences; partly: public or followers only; no: everything public.

whole-system-restore.name: Restore a whole computer
whole-system-restore.question: Can you bring back a whole computer, not just files, like Time Machine?
whole-system-restore.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: with extra steps; no: files only.

word-files.name: Opens Word files faithfully
word-files.question: Do Word (.docx) files open and save without the layout shifting?
word-files.meaning: Yes: complex files look the same; partly: simple files are fine but complex layouts, fonts or tables shift; no: can't open them.

word-plugin.name: Citations in Word and Google Docs
word-plugin.question: Can you insert citations and a bibliography while writing in Word, LibreOffice or Google Docs?
word-plugin.meaning: Yes: plugins for Word and at least one other; partly: one of them; no: none.

work-profiles.name: Work profiles
work-profiles.question: Can you show your work history and skills on a profile?
work-profiles.meaning: Yes: a structured CV-style profile; partly: free-text bio only; no: no.

works-in-browser.name: Works in a web browser
works-in-browser.question: Can you use it in a web browser with nothing to install?
works-in-browser.meaning: Yes: a full browser version; partly: only some features in the browser; no: you must install it.

works-offline.name: Works offline
works-offline.question: Does it keep working without an internet connection?
works-offline.meaning: Yes: everything important works offline; partly: you can read or view but not do everything; no: it needs a connection.

works-on-files.name: Works on your files and apps
works-on-files.question: Can it read and change your own files and use apps on your computer?
works-on-files.meaning: Yes: files and apps; partly: files only; no: neither.
